scope: Fixture-only TS-generated AArch64/Mach-O two-thread contention; no portable package, encoder, Script API, runtime context, job, waiter, default grant or catalog edits.

platform.main: ordinary platform main ABI; argc/argv ignored;96-byte16-aligned save frame; x19..x29/x30 restored
platform.create: x0=&raw pthread_t, x1=NULL attrs, x2=PC-relative generated worker bridge, x3=scalar record; w0 int status
platform.worker: x0 void* record on pthread-provided stack, return x0 null success/(void*)1 failure; no Tint context/function/general-value ABI
platform.join: x0 raw opaque pthread_t, x1=&raw void* result, w0 int status; no FP/integer boxing of handles
platform.calleeSaved: x19..x29 and original x30/SP restored; x18 and d8..d15 never touched

helper.construction: Public bindHostOperations verifies explicit six-number shared-compare-exchange-unsigned binding; public emitModule returns one NativeHelper with that kind, bounded offset/byteLength, no imports/managed imports. Public wrapper signature is six FP number parameters with no stack overflow slots; that wrapper is deliberately NOT used as a pthread entry.
helper.bridge: Generated worker supplies raw x0..x5 according to the helper contract. Byte audit verifies arg moves x3→x8(width),x4→x14(expected),x5→x13(replacement), payload address x10=x0+x2, and observed x11→x0 result.

audit.preserved: x16..x29 and FP/SIMD; x0..x15 and flags clobbered
audit.memory: only LDAXR/STLXR payload accesses through x10=base+offset; no literal loads, stack/context/GC/managed memory accesses

helper.negativeAuditTests: Reject out-of-range branch, BL call and ordinary context-like memory load at offset72.

protocol.control: one zero-initialized16KiB mmap; scalar records, raw thread/result words, start/abort/ready/loaded flags, counter and neighboring canaries
protocol.contention: controller waits for two ready flags; release start; each worker acquire-loads initial0 and publishes loaded; each waits for peer loaded before CAS. At least one semantic CAS mismatch is required for exit42.
protocol.work: 1000 successful increments per worker; actual existing width-aware CAS leaf; modular byte/halfword counter; bounded spin/mismatch budgets; both thread return/status/completed counts and adjacent bytes checked
protocol.cleanup: partial create failure publishes abort/start and joins every created worker; successful joins precede munmap; join failure retains mapping to process exit; explicit1..10 failure exits

passed; same frozen source/tooling and expected42; no native execution

preservedFailures.diagnosis: Encoder correctly rejected fixture add-immediate16384 with shift0. Encode4 shifted12 instead; no encoder change.
Fail-closed leaf verifier initially omitted non-flag SUB-register guard instruction; added the existing integer-only form to its whitelist.

New abort regression caught fixture compareImm overwriting x9 when x9 itself was compared. Use a distinct scratch; this fixes both worker abort checks and affected controller guards before any native build.

limits: No generated native binary has been launched by this agent. Root must verify stopped-at-entry and actual exit42 for each image under serial LLDB containment.

The cooperative model tests the generated worker bridge and CAS call contract, not hardware weak memory, native pthread behavior or the copied exclusive loop; the latter retains existing shared-leaf regression coverage.
These fixtures do not implement wait/notify, Script agents, shared moving heaps or concurrent GC.
OS pthread_create/join failures have cleanup paths but were not fault-injected natively. pthread_join is not timed; independent debugger/process containment remains required.
Finite worker budgets can fail on an excessively stalled system; failures must be retained, not retried away. CAS leaf progress/fairness is not guaranteed by these model checks.
